newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany ready to cooperate with new Zaire rulers.
newsitem.headline: Germany ready to cooperate with new Zaire rulers.

text.p: Germany said on Monday it was ready to cooperate with Zaire's new rulers under rebel leader Laurent Kabila, and urged them to ensure a rapid transition to democracy.
Foreign Ministry spokesman Martin Erdmann said there was no need for Bonn formally to recognise the new rulers, since it customarily recognises states, not governments.
"Our main wish is that the new government should quickly start a process of democratisation, which must lead to free and fair elections," he said.
"We are in principle prepared to cooperate with the new government. What this cooperation means in practice will be discussed among European Union members," Erdmann added.
On Saturday, German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel hailed the end of President Mobutu Sese Seko's 32-year rule and said it opened the way for a new, democratic start in Zaire.
